description: Review traces that must not appear in a review copy or in any path given to an agent (SPEC 15.5). Every regex is compiled with the flags shown plus 'g' and 'u'. data: true marks the few patterns that are unambiguous even in a short value of a LARGE data file (.csv .tsv .jsonl .ndjson .json over 1 MiB or 2 000 rows): short values (numbers, names) are scanned with them only, because ratings, 'panel', 'reviewer' and 'round 3' are ordinary words and values of real data (a shop rating 9,5, solar panels). Prose files, small data files and every prose-like value of a large data file (4 or more words, or 30 or more characters) are scanned with every pattern. scope: 'both' = file contents and path components; 'path' = path components only. strip.json traceAllow removes hits.
